import bpy, os, math, tempfile, base64
from mathutils import Vector
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
scene=bpy.context.scene
old_cam=scene.camera; old_engine=scene.render.engine; old_x=scene.render.resolution_x; old_y=scene.render.resolution_y; old_pct=scene.render.resolution_percentage; old_fmt=scene.render.image_settings.file_format; old_q=scene.render.image_settings.quality; old_path=scene.render.filepath
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'; scene.render.resolution_x=320; scene.render.resolution_y=240; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100; scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'; scene.render.image_settings.quality=28
camdata=bpy.data.cameras.new('QA_TEMP_CAM'); cam=bpy.data.objects.new('QA_TEMP_CAM',camdata); scene.collection.objects.link(cam); scene.camera=cam; camdata.lens=38; camdata.clip_end=2000
def bounds(coll):
 pts=[]
 for o in coll.all_objects:
  if o.type in {'MESH','FONT'}:
   try: pts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
   except: pass
 if not pts: return Vector((0,0,0)),Vector((1,1,1))
 mn=Vector((min(p.x for p in pts),min(p.y for p in pts),min(p.z for p in pts))); mx=Vector((max(p.x for p in pts),max(p.y for p in pts),max(p.z for p in pts))); return (mn+mx)/2,mx-mn
def render_b64(name,loc,target):
 cam.location=loc; cam.rotation_euler=(target-loc).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); path=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(),name+'.jpg'); scene.render.filepath=path; bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True); data=open(path,'rb').read(); os.remove(path); return base64.b64encode(data).decode('ascii')
low=bpy.data.collections.get('D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1'); elev=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
if not low or not elev: raise RuntimeError('colecoes QA ausentes')
lc,ls=bounds(low); ec,es=bounds(elev)
# frente da estação baixa: usa rotação da marquise legada
ref=bpy.data.objects.get('OFICIAL | Cidade Baixa | marquise'); th=ref.rotation_euler.z if ref else 0.0; front=Vector((math.sin(th),-math.cos(th),0)).normalized()
low_loc=lc+front*28+Vector((0,0,10)); low_tgt=lc+Vector((0,0,1.8))
over_loc=ec+Vector((95,-110,85)); over_tgt=ec+Vector((0,0,8))
try:
 print('LOWER_JPEG_B64='+render_b64('qa_lower',low_loc,low_tgt))
 print('OVERVIEW_JPEG_B64='+render_b64('qa_overview',over_loc,over_tgt))
 print(f'LOWER_CENTER={tuple(round(v,2) for v in lc)} LOWER_SIZE={tuple(round(v,2) for v in ls)}')
 print(f'ELEV_CENTER={tuple(round(v,2) for v in ec)} ELEV_SIZE={tuple(round(v,2) for v in es)}')
 print('VISUAL_QA_MINI_OK')
finally:
 scene.camera=old_cam; scene.render.engine=old_engine; scene.render.resolution_x=old_x; scene.render.resolution_y=old_y; scene.render.resolution_percentage=old_pct; scene.render.image_settings.file_format=old_fmt; scene.render.image_settings.quality=old_q; scene.render.filepath=old_path; bpy.data.objects.remove(cam,do_unlink=True); bpy.data.cameras.remove(camdata)
